gen-gf-noto-serif-grantha-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads hefty and broad, with generous openings in its c and s that never feel cramped. Noto Serif Grantha sits above it with its stubby ascenders and gentle stroke modulation, so bump the body size up a notch.
gen-gf-noto-serif-grantha-fs-supreme: Supreme lays down a thick, dense band of text, its letters held open rather than curled shut, while Noto Serif Grantha adds a faintly modulated, bookish line. One brings weight, the other a quiet editorial hand.
gen-gf-noto-serif-grantha-manrope: Stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height give Noto Serif Grantha its stamp, with strokes that vary like a gently used dip pen. Yet Manrope runs ruler-straight beneath it, bright and open, and that crisp difference is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-noto-serif-grantha-montserrat: Wiry, wide-eyed and bookish all at once, Noto Serif Grantha carries a moderate thick-thin ratio over Montserrat's oversized e and a counters. The serif does editorial character; Montserrat does gliding, unmodulated clarity.
gen-gf-noto-serif-grantha-satoshi: Approachable is the first word for Satoshi, with its soaring x-height. Against Noto Serif Grantha's modest stem-to-hairline ratio, its uniform outlines make the strongest quality here a clear split between bookish modulation and strokes with no swelling at all.
gen-gf-noto-serif-grantha-switzer: Switzer brings tubular, wire-like letterforms, with c tips that never drift toward touching and a tall waist line. Noto Serif Grantha earns its keep in large, brief headings, where its medium contrast and stubby ascenders show.
gen-gf-noto-serif-grantha-work-sans: Thin parts barely slimmer than the stems give Noto Serif Grantha a sturdy, editorial look, with big x-height and stubby ascenders. Work Sans follows with an unshaded, modern line and a high mean line, so the serif seems to speak while the sans simply states.
gen-gf-noto-serif-gujarati-archivo: Noto Serif Gujarati carries an authoritative, softly tilted-nib line. It excels at refined, oversized lowercase presence, while Archivo's outward-opening curves and commanding x-height handle the plain talking.
gen-gf-noto-serif-gujarati-fs-asap: Refined up top, readable below, with Noto Serif Gujarati's modest thick-thin contrast over Asap's open arcs and near-capital body height. The serif lends authority and oversized lowercase; Asap simply keeps the text moving.
gen-gf-noto-serif-gujarati-fs-epilogue: Approachable curves run through Epilogue, a thin steel rod bent into tall-bodied letters with stubby ascender tips. And Noto Serif Gujarati sits above it, rounded and slightly thickened at the sides, adding a refined, authoritative weight to that wiry line.
